facts.text: Hotel Valley Ho has welcomed guests in Old Town Scottsdale since 1956.
facts.excerpt: Since 1956, Hotel Valley Ho has been setting the scene for unforgettable stays in Old Town Scottsdale.

facts.text: The hotel has mid-century modern architecture and resort-style grounds.
facts.excerpt: Discover iconic mid-century modern architecture, lush resort-style grounds

facts.text: The hotel is in a walkable location steps from Old Town Scottsdale's dining, nightlife and shopping.
facts.excerpt: a walkable location just steps from the area

facts.text: Guests can choose rooms in the historic hotel or contemporary rooms in The Tower.
facts.excerpt: Choose the historically hip hotel or upgrade to a contemporary and luxurious room in The Tower.

facts.text: There is no resort fee.
facts.excerpt: No resort fee + earn rewards

facts.text: Rooms have a private patio or balcony, floor-to-ceiling glass and Red Flower bath amenities.
facts.excerpt:
- Private patio or balcony
- Floor-to-ceiling glass
- Pillow-top bed
- Bath amenities from Red Flower

facts.text: Studio Guest Rooms have an oversized tub in the middle of the room.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a soak in the oversized tub in the middle of the room.

facts.text: Cabana Guest Rooms have an oversized patio near the OH Pool or OHasis Pool, surrounded by greenery and historic architecture.
facts.excerpt: from your oversized patio near the OH Pool or OHasis Pool, surrounded by lush greenery and historic architecture.

facts.text: The Terrace Suite has a huge wrap-around terrace.
facts.excerpt: venture outdoors to the huge, wrap-around terrace

facts.text: The Hideaway Suite has a living room with a wet bar and a wrap-around terrace.
facts.excerpt: Kick back in the living room (complete with a wet bar) or lounge on the wrap-around terrace.

facts.text: The Tower Loft Suite has a full kitchen and living room upstairs, the bedroom downstairs, and views of Camelback Mountain or Downtown Scottsdale from private patios.
facts.excerpt: Upstairs is a full kitchen and spacious living room, with the master bedroom and bathroom downstairs. Enjoy views of Camelback Mountain or Downtown Scottsdale from your private patios.

facts.text: Tower Suites have a fully appointed kitchen, in-suite laundry and a private balcony with views of Downtown Scottsdale or Camelback Mountain.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a fully appointed kitchen, spacious living area and in-suite laundry. Relax on your private balcony and admire views of Downtown Scottsdale or Camelback Mountain.

facts.text: VH Spa offers treatments such as hot stone massages, antioxidant facials and sauna time with chromotherapy.
facts.excerpt: Treat yourself to revitalizing treatments like hot stone massages, antioxidant facials and sauna time with chromotherapy.

facts.text: The OH Pool has a poolside scene with seasonal entertainment.
facts.excerpt: Grab a chaise and check out the scene poolside, complete with seasonal entertainment.

facts.text: The Ohasis Pool is set up for leisurely laps and lounging under the palms.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy leisurely laps and poolside lounging under the palms

facts.text: Private daybeds and cabanas can be booked by the pool.
facts.excerpt: relax like poolside royalty in your own private daybed or cabana

facts.text: The fitness center is open 24/7 with Peloton bikes.
facts.excerpt: Keep your health top of mind with a visit to our fitness center—open 24/7. Work out with free weights, modern equipment, Peloton bikes, private TVs and more.

facts.text: ZuZu restaurant serves an eclectic menu, bold cocktails and inventive desserts.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a delightfully eclectic menu, bold cocktails and inventive desserts.

facts.text: Weddings can be held in the courtyard, with dancing on the rooftop or in the historic ballroom.
facts.excerpt: Say your vows in our lush courtyard, then dance the night away on the rooftop or in our historic ballroom.

facts.text: Event venues include Sands and the Sky Line Rooftop.
facts.excerpt: unique venues like Sands and the Sky Line Rooftop are ideal for sunset cocktail hour and themed dinners

facts.text: Cabana Guest Rooms require a two-night minimum stay on weekends from March to September.
facts.excerpt: two-night min. stay on weekends (March – September)

facts.text: Suites such as the Terrace, Hideaway, Tower and Tower Loft Suites require a two-night minimum stay on weekends.
facts.excerpt: two-night min. stay on weekends

facts.text: Rooftop yoga sessions are offered as Private Prana.
facts.excerpt: ROOFTOP YOGA SESSIONS

facts.text: The hotel celebrates its 70th anniversary.
facts.excerpt: IT’S OUR 70TH ANNIVERSARY!

facts.text: The hotel calls itself Scottsdale done differently.
facts.excerpt: this is Scottsdale done differently
